roleTitle: User Research Operations Specialist, E-commerce Fulfilment Software
jobDescription: The e-commerce fulfilment software vendor runs research with merchant operations staff and warehouse users. The User Research Operations Specialist owns research operations end-to-end: runs the participant panel, holds the budget and approval for participant incentives, leads the research operations review with the design leads, and is accountable to the director of design for panel health and consent compliance.
requirements: Owns research operations end-to-end, including the participant panel and the approval of participant incentives within the research budget.
Runs the participant panel and maintains the panel, screening and consent records.
Leads the monthly research operations review with the design leads and records decisions.
Coordinates research sessions with merchant success and legal and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents known limitations and hand-over conditions for each research round.

evidence.text: Owned research operations for the fulfilment product for two and a half years, holding the research incentive budget and approving participant incentives myself as the budget holder recorded in the finance system.
Ran the participant panel of merchant operations staff and warehouse users, maintaining the panel, screening and consent records in the research tool and refreshing the panel every quarter.
Led the monthly research operations review with the design leads, deciding panel priorities and incentive levels and recording the decisions in the review notes.

Coordinated research sessions with merchant success and legal, recording that merchant success owned the merchant relationship and legal owned the consent template while I owned scheduling, incentives and panel records.
Responsibilities included research operations ownership, the incentive budget, the participant panel and the monthly operations review over about two and a half years.

Work sample: the finance system's budget-holder record for the research incentive budget, the incentive approval log under the candidate's user id and one monthly review note, with the research tool's record identifiers as a verification trail.
Reference call with the former director of design: confirmed the candidate held the incentive budget, ran the panel and led the monthly review; confirmed employment dates.
Recruiter logistics note: candidate is available for an on-site session next week; notice period is six weeks.

propositions.text: The candidate ran the participant panel of merchant operations staff and warehouse users and maintained the panel, screening and consent records.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the panel and records directly.

propositions.text: The candidate coordinated research sessions with merchant success and legal and recorded who owned the relationship, the consent template and the panel records.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the coordination and the recorded boundaries.

propositions.text: The candidate owned research operations, held the research incentive budget as recorded budget holder, approved incentives and led the monthly research operations review.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the budget-holder record, the approval log and the reference state the ownership, the budget and the review leadership.

gold.expectedGap: Hand-over conditions for each research round are only partly documented in the review notes.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the ownership as documented: the incentive budget, the panel and the review; do not extend it to the consent template, which legal owned.
followUpTargets: Ask how hand-over conditions were recorded for each research round.
